findings.current: Even if we have more than thirty thousand allied troops
findings.defect: “More than thirty thousand” omits the additional several thousand specified in the source.
findings.rationale: 삼만 하고도 수천 gives a total in the thirty-thousands, not merely a number above thirty thousand.
findings.replacement: Even if we have thirty thousand allied troops and several thousand more
findings.source: 삼만 하고도 수천에 달하는 아군 병력이 있다고 해도

findings.current: And that was when I noticed someone in the middle of the scene before me, silently watching it all: the only one standing straight-backed.
findings.defect: The draft assigns the silent watching to Sama Pyo instead of the narrator and implies Pyo is standing.
findings.rationale: 내 시야에 identifies the narrator as the observer; 허리를 꼿꼿이 펴고 describes posture, not standing.
findings.replacement: And that was when, as I silently watched the scene before me, I noticed the only one among them sitting with his back straight.
findings.source: 눈 앞에 펼쳐진 광경을 말없이 응시하던 내 시야에, 그들 중 유일하게 허리를 꼿꼿이 펴고 있던 누군가의 모습이 들어온 것은.

findings.defect: “Followers” loses the narrator’s disparaging comparison to lackeys.
findings.rationale: 졸개들 carries a contemptuous sense absent from the neutral “followers.”

findings.current: The ones who had ruled Gansu for decades, some of them for over a hundred years?
findings.defect: The draft assigns the longer tenure to particular individuals and changes longstanding local fixtures into rulers.
findings.rationale: 터줏대감 conveys being long-established in the region; the passage does not say that individual men ruled it for over a century.
findings.replacement: Men whose families had been fixtures in Gansu for decades, even more than a century?
findings.source: 짧게는 수십 년에서 길게는 백 년이 넘도록 감숙성의 터줏대감이었던 그들이

findings.current: Before the echo of his own voice had faded
findings.defect: “His own voice” incorrectly ties the lingering words to the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord rather than Sima Gong’s preceding answer.
findings.rationale: The realization follows Sima Gong’s answer about choosing the best odds of victory.
findings.replacement: Before Sima Gong’s words had even faded
findings.source: 앞서 흘린 음성의 여운이 사라지기도 전에

findings.current: A Meeting When the Yellow River Runs Clear.
findings.defect: The relevant explanatory footnote is defined but never referenced.
findings.rationale: The existing note explains why the river running clear matters to the otherwise puzzling phrase.
findings.replacement: A Meeting When the Yellow River Runs Clear.[^1]

summary: Several localized fidelity issues affect troop numbers, who is observing the meeting, and the source of the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord’s realization. The explanatory footnote also lacks a reference.
